meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 在 macOS 菜单栏添加一个闪电图标:NanoClaw 运行时显示绿点、停止时显示红点,并提供 Start、Stop、Restart 控制。
howto.when: 仅限 macOS,且需要 Xcode Command Line Tools(swiftc);若已安装则直接跳到验证步骤。当你想给 NanoClaw 加菜单栏状态图标时使用。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 macOS 菜单栏状态图标
say.note: 会编译 Swift 程序并注册 launchd 服务

say.text: 检查一下菜单栏状态图标装好了没
say.note: 用 launchctl list 查看是否已有 PID

say.text: 在菜单栏闪电图标里重启 NanoClaw
say.note: Restart 用于改完代码后重启

howto.what_en: Adds a persistent macOS menu bar bolt icon for NanoClaw: a green dot when it is running, a red dot when stopped, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls.
howto.when_en: macOS only, and requires Xcode Command Line Tools (swiftc). Use it when you want a NanoClaw menu bar status indicator; if already installed it skips to verify.

say_en.text: Add the macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw
say_en.note: Compiles the Swift binary and loads a launchd service

say_en.text: Check whether the menu bar status indicator is installed
say_en.note: Runs launchctl list to look for a PID

say_en.text: Restart NanoClaw from the menu bar bolt icon
say_en.note: Use Restart after making code changes
